values.label: In Copyright: Assessed - LOW RISK
values.description: This statement should be used for material where our copyright risk assessment has determined that it is very low risk and no due diligence is required. This may include unpublished material subject to the 2039 rule, material where we do not know the end copyright date and low risk published material. [Ask Jodie if ok to include 2039 material if we aren't doing this level of due diligence]

values.label: In Copyright: Assessed - LOW RISK (Online -orphan work)
values.description: To be applied to non 2039 works where some due diligence efforts have been made

values.label: In Copyright: Assessed - LOW RISK (Online -orphan work-2039)
values.description: To be applied to unpublished material (archives) where some due diligence efforts have been made [Ask Jodie if we need to link to takedown?]

values.label: In Copyright: Assessed - LOW RISK (University of Leeds copyright - online)
values.description: To be applied to copyright material of UoL (e.g. material derived from the University, it's departments or activities wholly funded by the university, unless explicitly belonging to any other third party) where there are no restrictions and can be put online.

values.label: In Copyright: Assessed - MEDIUM RISK (dedicated terminal)
values.description: This statement should be used for material where our copyright risk assessment has determined that it is medium risk and no due diligence has been done.

values.label: In Copyright: Assessed - HIGH RISK
values.description: This statement should be used for material that is assessed as high risk copyright (we would not put it online) but there are no copyright holder or donor restrictions on copying for personal research. We are allowed to copy for research, private study or other purposes permitted by copyright legislation.

values.label: In Copyright: Assessed - HIGH RISK (orphan work)
values.description: To be applied to non 2039 works where some due diligence efforts have been made and deemed to be high risk (e.g. active or high profile estate).

values.label: In Copyright: Assessed - HIGH RISK (orphan work-2039)
values.description: To be applied to unpublished material (archives) where some due diligence efforts have been made and deemed to be high risk (e.g. active or high profile estate)

values.label: In Copyright: Assessed - HIGH RISK (University of Leeds copyright)
values.description: To be applied to copyright material of UoL (e.g. material derived from the University, it's departments or activities wholly funded by the university, unless explicitly belonging to any other third party) where there is a higher risk to online publication.

values.label: In Copyright (contractual restrictions apply) - HIGH RISK
values.description: Ask Jodie if we can have a generic licensing statement to cover scenarios such as Adam Matthew arrangement

values.label: In Copyright: Unassessed
values.description: This statement should be used for cases where no assessment on copyright duration, ownership and risk has been carried out. This will be non-public content - only be viewable in the research centre if PA conditions allow (either physically or via dedicated terminal).

values.label: In Copyright (holder restrictions) - HIGH RISK - PRESERVATION COPIES ONLY
values.description: This is to be used in the last instance where a high risk work with restrictions on copying is digitised on preservation grounds to provide a surrogate for access and reduce risk to handling the physical item. This can only apply to donated material and not material held on deposit (as per copyright exception).

categories.label: Out of Copyright (Public Domain / CC0)
categories.description: copyright expired based upon UK legislation; copyright holder has waived their rights

categories.label: In Copyright: Assessed (Low Risk)
categories.description: determined low risk based upon the Risk Management Framework (RMF); low risk permission granted by rights holder; low risk - Orphan Work; low risk - 2039 Rule

categories.label: In Copyright: Assessed (Medium Risk)
categories.description: determined medium risk based upon the Risk Management Framework (RMF); in contract material with access restrictions while in contract

categories.label: In Copyright: Assessed (High Risk)
categories.description: determined high risk based upon the Risk Management Framework (RMF)

categories.label: In Copyright: Unassessed
categories.description: material assumed in copyright upon acquisition / deposit; no assessment of holder or status; copyright holder/estate is not known to be high risk or with specific access conditions at the time of acquisition or deposit; further assessment required prior to publishing online

categories.label: In Copyright: Holder Conditions (High Risk)
categories.description: copyright holder restrictions limiting access or reproductions; preservation copies only; permission from copyright holder required prior to access
